changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate dataset entries (INSPEC, KRAPIVIN, SEMEVAL were case variations). Removed CopyRNN* as it's just an implementation variant, not a distinct model. Verified all remaining items are correctly extracted from the paper.

Removed P@k and R@k as they appear to be formula placeholders, not specific metrics used for evaluation. Normalized metric names by removing spaces in F1 variants. All specific metrics mentioned in evaluation sections are included.
Removed 'None' placeholders as they're not valid values. Verified no LLM-based evaluation is used in this paper (published in 2020 before widespread LLM-as-judge practices).
Removed 'None' placeholders. Verified no human evaluation is conducted in this paper - all evaluation is based on automatic metrics against ground truth keyphrases.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on automatic evaluation of keyphrase generation using standard precision/recall/F1 metrics with novel variations (F1@O, F1@M). No human or LLM evaluation is conducted. The extraction was generally accurate with minor normalization needed for dataset names and metric formatting.
